arabic_html:
ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ
وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۞
translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely.
explanation_html: If there is no god but Him, then there is no one else worth leaning on. Ibn Kathīr: take Him alone as your Trustee — reliance follows from believing He is One.
explanation_vo: If there is no god but Him, then there is no one else worth leaning on. Ibn Kathir: take Him alone as your Trustee — reliance follows from believing He is One.
